Script:2.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|What's the meaning of this!?  Faust how did you escape?

Script:3.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|Welcome home, I am your new king!  I have always longed for this day.

Script:4.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|Where is my father?  You'll pay for your crimes, I'll punch you in the head myself!

Script:5.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|I will be the rightful king and you will be my lovely queen!

Script:6.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|You scoundrel!  I'll never love you!  No way!  Never ever!

Script:7.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|In time my darling Chai, you will grow to love me.  Guards, take her to her room.

Script:8.2: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|Stradlater you idiot!  How could you betray us?  This isn't like you at all!

Script:9.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|You will not understand but I have seen the future and this is the right path.

Script:10.6: scene-dialog-open|nana|1|What sad times, to be ruled by such a pathetic man!

Script:15.5: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|What vile creatures in our very own cathedral!

Script:17.1: scene-dialog-open|ranq|2|Thank goodness you are here Master Wren!  Our grounds are being overrun!

Script:18.1: scene-dialog-open|fpal|1|You must go quickly there is not much time!  Thomas is outside fending off the horde.

Script:19.3: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|I am stronger than ever!  No evil shall set foot on these holy grounds while I am alive!

Script:27.6: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|I will find Thomas and defeat these strange evil creatures!

Script:28.1: scene-dialog-open|ranq|2|This is the work of that traitor Faust.  Godspeed friend!

Script:31.1: scene-dialog-open|nana|1|Princess!  Thank goodness you're finally home!

Script:36.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|0|Who's this?  Not even our secret cave is safe from trouble!

Script:37.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|1|Brother, he looks scary!  I've seen him before, isn't he the mad butcher?

Script:38.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|0|How many people did he kill?  I heard that even ghosts are afraid of him!

Script:40.1: scene-dialog-open|az|0|If I killed them, they probably deserved death ...

Script:41.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|1|Oh my God is he awake?  Are we going to die?!

Script:43.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|2|He's just talking in his sleep.  I'm not afraid of anything!

Script:44.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|1|Maybe he can help us fight the evil queen!  Please help us Mister Butcher!

Script:45.1: scene-dialog-open|az|0|I will not harm the queen ...

Script:46.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|2|He won't help us, he just wants money!  That's what all adults want!

Script:47.4: scene-dialog-open|leena|1|I remember your name was Azrael.  The queen is evil please help us ...

Script:49.4: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|0|What were those damn kids doing here?  No matter, you are my greatest achievement ever!

Script:50.1: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|0|Miwa will love me more than Thorn!  Just a human bounty hunter?  I have a drow!

Script:51.1: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|0|Awaken from your month-long sleep.  You are a gift to my beloved queen.

Script:52.2: scene-dialog-open|az|2|Yes I will awaken and serve my new master ...

Script:57.1: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|0|Beautiful Queen Miwa is ruling a small town.  Seek her and wreak havoc on the way!

Script:58.2: scene-dialog-open|az|2|Yes I will serve Queen Miwa ...

Script:61.19: scene-mission-open|290|Fight your way to the end!

Script:76.1: scene-dialog-open|dor|0|I'm mad!  Why do we have to take orders from that weak human Faust?

Script:77.1: scene-dialog-open|mwa|1|Taking over this land will be easy!  I will be cleansing any living majins left.

Script:78.1: scene-dialog-open|puck|2|The drow are supposed to be powerful, but I destroyed that Evanstaul so easily!

Script:79.1: scene-dialog-open|dor|0|Faust would be gone if it weren't for seer Stradlater protecting him.

Script:80.1: scene-dialog-open|mwa|1|Stradlater predicts that we will all be killed.  How foolish he has no idea of our power!

Script:81.1: scene-dialog-open|sda|2|What rubbish, I shall amuse myself elsewhere ...

Script:84.subtitle: Assassin Road

Script:97.1: scene-dialog-open|grisa|0|My queen, we found these two dumb brats stealing gold from the barracks!

Script:98.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|1|That's not your money!  I need it more than you!

Script:99.2: scene-dialog-open|mwa|2|Come here you handsome little boy.  I see you very clearly, you are an evil warlock!

Script:100.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|0|Wait, that's not true!  How can you say that?

Script:101.1: scene-dialog-open|mwa|2|The punishment for witchery is death for your bloodline that includes your poor sister!

Script:102.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|1|This is stupid, I'm not a warlock.  I'm just a kid, this is not fair at all!

Script:103.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|0|Why don't you just leave us all alone!?  What did we do to you?

Script:104.3: scene-dialog-open|mwa|2|How dare you little insects talk back to me!  Put them with the other heretics!

Script:105.1: scene-dialog-open|grisa|0|You little thieves made a big mistake and you're gonna pay big for it!

Script:108.20: scene-mission-open|290|Fight your way to the end!
Script:108.title: CHAPTER {chapter}
Script:108.subtitle: Oberat Revisited

Script:109.1: scene-mission-open|290|You have aquired three drow acolytes!

Script:118.2: scene-dialog-open|puck|2|Bah, you mean that weakling Oberat!?  He was nothing and so was Evanstaul!

Script:119.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|No matter I will just kill you again like I did before ...

Script:120.1: scene-dialog-open|puck|2|You fool even in my weakened state you are no match!

Script:55.1: scene-dialog-open|puck|2|You were lucky this time drow.  But we will meet again!

Script:127.1: scene-dialog-open|eva|0|We are like sisters you and I, both our fathers were killed.

Script:128.1: scene-dialog-open|luc|2|I was almost burned at the stake.  You saved my life so now I can redeem myself.

Script:129.1: scene-dialog-open|eva|0|Use what you learned and never be afraid.  Let nothing stand in your way.

Script:130.1: scene-dialog-open|luc|2|I'm doing this for my mother and father.  Don't worry about me at all.

Script:131.1: scene-dialog-open|eva|0|We must strike back at those vile elves.  I must go now but I will always be near ...

Script:133.7: scene-dialog-open|fswan|0|I am to follow you.  Please be careful there are many bad monsters around!

Script:134.1: scene-dialog-open|luc|2|I won't allow anyone else to get hurt by them.  Tell me what I must do!

Script:137.subtitle: A Dangerous Path

Script:148.1: scene-dialog-open|nana|0|Chai my dear are you okay?

Script:149.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|Nana, how could this happen?  Where's my father?

Script:150.1: scene-dialog-open|nana|0|Faust is a horrible man!  We have to get you out of here soon and find the king.

Script:151.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|He was always power hungry.  That's why he was banished in the first place!

Script:152.1: scene-dialog-open|nana|0|He brought with him those strange killers.  They are taking over the kingdom!

Script:153.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|He's the same stupid guy, he just needs a good swift kick to set him right!

Script:154.1: scene-dialog-open|nana|0|No, please be careful, he's not the same as you remembered!

Script:155.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|Don't worry, I'm smart enough to deal with him!

Script:158.2: scene-dialog-open|nana|1|Fine, but I'm going to be right next door!  Hear me?

Script:159.2: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|Do not worry your father is safe.  I will rule wisely like it should have been.

Script:160.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|This is wrong, why did you come back here and cause all this trouble?

Script:161.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|Nothing can keep me away from you!  I will protect this kingdom and protect you.

Script:162.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|Well, maybe you're right.  Let's see if you really become a good king as you say ...

Script:163.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|Thank you for giving me a chance my dearest Chai.  I shall do my best!

Script:179.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|What's wrong, is she okay?  So many things have happened while I was away.

Script:180.1: scene-dialog-open|fswan|0|They killed her father then she went mad.  She is much older and is not the same.

Script:181.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|She is much stronger than me.  I am trapped here, but I will find a way out!

Script:182.1: scene-dialog-open|fswan|0|Please be cautious there may be forces coming to this castle.  Take care of yourself!

Script:185.25: scene-mission-open|290|Fight with the knights to pass the bridge!

Script:189.12: scene-dialog-open|sda|0|What a bore!  Left to guard a bridge against all of these weakling humans.

Script:190.3: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|2|Hail, I bring a message from our great Lord Oberon!

Script:191.1: scene-dialog-open|sda|0|What nonsense comes again from our dear lord?

Script:192.1: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|2|"Do not engage the drow and the halfling."  That is his holy command.

Script:193.1: scene-dialog-open|sda|0|Why would I fear any human or an abomination?  Does he truly think so little of me?

Script:194.1: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|2|You just came from ether and not fully restored.  But I do not care at all, do what you will.

Script:196.1: scene-dialog-open|eva|0|There is one of four elves.  Use the skills I have taught you.  I leave this to you.

Script:197.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|1|He looks very confident, but I won't be afraid no matter what the odds are!

Script:198.1: scene-dialog-open|sda|0|What a mere woman and child?  I can never forgive this blatant mockery!

Script:122.1: scene-dialog-open|sda|2|Impossible, I will not be defeated by you again!

Script:207.1: scene-dialog-open|dor|2|Do not fear human, I was merely testing your grand fortune telling abilities!

Script:208.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|0|This act will not go unpunished, follow your orders fool!

Script:209.1: scene-dialog-open|dor|2|Let's see if you can protect yourself as well as you can protect Faust!

Script:215.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|0|This is your last chance to fall into line with merciful King Faust.  Stand down!

Script:216.1: scene-dialog-open|dor|2|I don't take orders from puny humans, no matter what Oberon says!

Script:217.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|0|Decide at your own peril.  I will punish you swiftly.

Script:218.1: scene-dialog-open|dor|2|Your seer vision can't predict the attacks of someone as powerful as me!

Script:224.1: scene-dialog-open|dor|0|A drow trick! That's all it was.  I won't fall for that again!

Script:225.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|I will let you live this time, the next time you disobey it will be your last!

Script:228.16: scene-mission-open|290|Fight your way to the end!

Script:239.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|How could you let him live?  You are more merciful than I could ever be.

Script:240.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|He gave me a bad wake up.  But he learned his lesson.

Script:241.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|What a great day!  I will finally be king and marry my one true love!

Script:242.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|Respectfully Lord, you cannot force someone to love you.

Script:243.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|How dare you!?  Is that one of your predictions!?

Script:246.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|You choose your words wisely, know your place!

Script:247.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|Would you rather I lie, or do you want to hear the truth?

Script:249.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|She will love me, no matter what your predictions!

Script:250.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|I was not predicting my lord.  Just giving friendly advice.

Script:251.3: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|Fine we shall forget this incident ever happened ...

Script:266.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|Hang on, I will be there soon!

Script:273.1: scene-dialog-open|dlrd|0|Sire she was caught trying to leave the castle in disguise.

Script:274.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|How could you?  I thought you truly believed in me!

Script:275.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|I'm not going to be a prisoner, I don't want to be here!

Script:276.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|I treat you well and this is how you repay me?

Script:277.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|This is not being treated well.  I want to see my father!

Script:278.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|That is enough!  Tomorrow we will be married whether you want to or not!

Script:279.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|I will never marry you!  Not in a million-billion years!

Script:280.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|Everyone start the preparations for the grand wedding!

Script:283.22: scene-mission-open|290|Thomas must survive to the end!
Script:283.title: CHAPTER {chapter}

Script:295.2: scene-dialog-open|dlrd|2|This is the end of the paladin enclave.  You shall not pass!

Script:296.2: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|You and your traitor dreadlords will face justice!

Script:304.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|0|You, you left me there to die!  In that bad and putrid place!

Script:305.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|I did not abandon you!  I thought you were dead.  I had to help Faust for the future!

Script:306.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|0|Lies and excuses!  You were to help me arrest him.  You betrayed me!

Script:307.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|You just do not understand.  I have seen the future, this is what must be done!

Script:308.1: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|1|Bah, just kill him already my pet.  Stop wasting time!

Script:311.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|0|I may not be able to kill you, but I can make you hurt!

Script:312.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|You are acting strange, is someone controlling you?  There is no need to fight.

Script:313.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|0|I know something you don't want me to know.  Maybe a little girl of yours?

Script:314.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|How could you know anything about that?  Sorry but I cannot allow you to leave!

Script:316.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|No one knows my secret.  I pray that Lucette will be safe!

Script:332.1: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|1|I say, I was wrong about you old fellow.  You are quite the dramatic one indeed!

Script:333.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|0|He will suffer almost as much as I did in that world!

Script:336.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|0|Damn, a drow fighter!?  I can't win against you.

Script:337.1: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|1|What's wrong you idiot?  Just shoot her damn it all!

Script:338.1: scene-dialog-open|eva|2|Insolent fool of a man, who sent you here and why?

Script:339.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|0|The accursed father of that girl sent me.  It's my revenge against him!

Script:340.1: scene-dialog-open|luc|2|What!?  My father is alive?  Is that really true?

Script:341.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|0|Yes alive and with our bounty stupid king Faust, while leaving me to die.

Script:342.1: scene-dialog-open|luc|2|All this time and he was alive?  I must see him now!

Script:343.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|0|Now that I can't kill you I have to find other ways to inflict great pain!

Script:346.32: scene-mission-open|290|Fight your way to the end!
Script:346.title: CHAPTER {chapter}

Script:347.1: scene-mission-open|290|You have aquired three drow acolytes!

Script:357.1: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|0|I can't wait to see my gift, you will never believe it!

Script:358.1: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|2|Someone as untalented as you?  What can you possibly bring?

Script:359.1: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|0|He was just sleeping there and never woke up, I had his ear for an entire month!

Script:360.1: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|2|What human sleeps for a month?  What gleeful nonsense you are spewing.

Script:361.1: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|0|Fine! I will ruin the surprise.  I have a drow, a real drow!

Script:362.1: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|2|Are you crazy!?  It won't be that easy controlling a drow!  Cancel this now!

Script:363.1: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|0|I knew it!  You're just jealous!  With this gift Miwa will love me much more than you!

Script:364.1: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|2|If you don't have control it will be the death of us!  Idiot, you clearly know nothing!

Script:365.1: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|0|Ha, trust in me.  He will come as a willing slave ...

Script:368.title: CHAPTER {chapter}
Script:368.subtitle: Miwa the Enchantress

Script:369.1: scene-mission-open|290|You have aquired three drow warlords!

Script:377.6: scene-dialog-open|mwa|2|So little Leaf, is this your glorious gift to your queen?

Script:378.1: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|1|Yes he will be your most loyal and most powerful servant, a human drow!

Script:379.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|0|He changed his mind!  Please save us mister drow!

Script:380.1: scene-dialog-open|mwa|2|Fool girl!  If this is truly my servant, your first task is to kill the girl!

Script:381.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|Yes I will kill the girl ...

Script:382.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|2|No! I went and got lots of gold for you, I hid it under a tree!  I'll give it all to you I promise!

Script:383.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|1|Don't kill us please!  We aren't witches.  Please Sir Azrael!

Script:385.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|You're so very fortunate.  You said my name and I remembered it all.

Script:386.1: scene-dialog-open|mwa|2|Obey me you lowly human!  Your queen gave you an order!

Script:387.1: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|1|Forgive me my queen!  Thorn was right all along.

Script:388.1: scene-dialog-open|mwa|2|Ha!  It was one of Stradlater's fool predictions, that I would die at the hands of a human.

Script:389.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|I have waited a long time and awoke to get my revenge against all of you idiots!

Script:390.1: scene-dialog-open|mwa|2|I will prove to that seer that we elves are not bound by his predictions!

Script:396.1: scene-dialog-open|mwa|2|Wretched human!  You bruised my beautiful face, you will pay for that!

Script:399.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|This is the happiest day of my life!  You will be mine.

Script:400.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|I won't be apart of this fake wedding!  I don't love you and I never will!

Script:401.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|I cherish you but today you will marry me whether you want to or not.

Script:402.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|This is just crazy!  Listen to me carefully, I don't love you, in fact, I hate you even more!

Script:404.2: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|Fine, this wedding is over.  Cancel everything, I give up ...

Script:407.6: scene-dialog-open|dlrd|0|Sire, thousands of orcs and other enemy forces are attacking the kingdom!

Script:408.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|Everyone evacuate the castle!  We will travel to the north.

Script:409.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|Retreat from my father's kingdom so easily?  Why not fight them off!?

Script:410.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|The elves betrayed me, we cannot win this battle.  Let us leave here now!

Script:416.25: scene-mission-open|290|Fight your way to the end!
Script:416.title: CHAPTER {chapter}
Script:416.subtitle: Dor the Champion

Script:426.3: scene-dialog-open|dor|2|I am the one who will kill that stupid human Faust!  No elf obeys a human!

Script:427.1: scene-dialog-open|fswan|1|Oh dear, Lucette!  This elf is very powerful, reinforcements are coming soon!

Script:428.2: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|I won't disappoint Master Evalun!  I will use full power!

Script:434.1: scene-dialog-open|dor|2|Damn all of you humans!  I'll kill every one of you!

Script:437.12: scene-dialog-open|wren|0|We shall reclaim the castle and vanquish these foes!

Script:438.1: scene-dialog-open|az|2|I'm just here to beat these idiots back where they belong!

Script:442.1: scene-mission-open|290|Wren and Azrael must survive fight with them!

Script:443.2: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|Thank you for helping me.  Evalun has given me the task of finding the elvish portal.

Script:444.2: scene-dialog-open|az|1|Yes I thought they killed her too, but she is strong.  We must avenge our master Evanstaul.

Script:445.2: scene-dialog-open|wren|2|We paladins will bring the traitor to justice, our army is massing.  Goodspeed to you friends!

Script:450.35: scene-mission-open|290|Thomas must survive to the end!
Script:450.title: CHAPTER {chapter}
Script:450.subtitle: Stradlater the Seer

Script:456.4: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|It is too late fellow paladins.  Forgive me, but this shall be your final resting place.

Script:460.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|You may have defeated me now, but you cannot stop the future, it is destiny!

Script:462.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|However noble you think your cause you are still a damned traitor to your race!

Script:463.2: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|If you only knew what I know you would do the same!

Script:464.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|I will no longer listen to your lies!  Prepare yourself!

Script:465.1: scene-dialog-open|tom|1|I will fight till the very end of my life master Wren!

Script:469.1: scene-dialog-open|tom|0|Master, what's wrong?  Are you alright?

Script:470.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|2|I used too much magic and it is draining my soul ...

Script:471.1: scene-dialog-open|tom|0|Master, please stay alive!  We're almost to the end of this, just a little more to go!

Script:472.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|2|Leave me, I cannot go any further.  Thomas, find the portal before it is too late ...

Script:473.1: scene-dialog-open|tom|0|I just can't leave you here!  After all you've done for me.  I owe you my life!

Script:474.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|2|Do not worry.  Listen to my orders apprentice: go find the portal now!

Script:475.58: scene-mission-open|290|Fight your way to the end!
Script:475.title: CHAPTER {chapter}
Script:475.subtitle: Elvish Vengence

Script:481.4: scene-dialog-open|mwa|2|Wretched drow, you bruised my face and for that you will feel unending pain!

Script:482.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|So you all waited for me, eh?

Script:483.2: scene-dialog-open|puck|2|Overconfident?  We have recovered from the ether.  We are more powerful than ever!

Script:484.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|Ha, I let you fools live just so I can see your limits.

Script:485.3: scene-dialog-open|dor|2|Stupid humans always getting in my way.  This time I won't hold back!

Script:486.4: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|I waited one month for this!  I'm gonna send you all to hell!

Script:490.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|My task is finally done.  Could it be true that they killed Lord Evanstaul?

Script:491.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|He said he couldn't be killed.  I will find him and show him how powerful I really am!

Script:492.29: scene-mission-open|290|Fight your way to the end!
Script:492.title: CHAPTER {chapter}
Script:492.subtitle: Father and Daughter

Script:498.21: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|Is this the portal?  I'm just a girl I shouldn't be doing this!

Script:499.2: scene-dialog-open|fswan|2|Be strong Lucette!  I will do what I can to help you.

Script:639.2: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|I have faded memories of you.  Are you really my father?

Script:514.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|Yes Lucette I am your father.  I am so sorry I did not want you to get involved in this.

Script:515.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|I've been so alone for so many years!  Why did you leave me?

Script:516.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|I cannot explain right now, but you must trust me that all I want to do is protect you.

Script:518.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|Does it have to do with these invaders and the portal?  Is that the reason you left!?

Script:519.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|Wait!  The great evil is coming but it is too soon for you!

Script:521.1: scene-dialog-open|draco|0|What land is this?  These pathetic insects look even weaker than the elves!

Script:640.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|Run!  This is not your fight!

Script:645.1: scene-dialog-open|p1|0|What were those snake creatures?  What's going on!?

Script:646.1: scene-dialog-open|strd|2|There will be more of them coming.  I will tell you everything I know ...

Script:524.1: scene-dialog-open|luc|2|My name is Lucette.  Don't be afraid.  I'm here for the portal.

Script:525.1: scene-dialog-open|tom|0|My name is Tom.  We have the same mission.  What should we do with it?

Script:526.1: scene-dialog-open|luc|2|I guess we should destroy it so they can't use it again.

Script:527.1: scene-dialog-open|tom|0|It's circle magic.  I know what to do!  I will use Vas Grav to destroy it!

Script:528.1: scene-dialog-open|luc|2|I have a bad feeling about this.  Please be very careful!

Script:531.1: scene-dialog-open|tom|0|Hm, nothing happened.  But, I feel kinda dizzy.

Script:533.1: scene-dialog-open|luc|2|Tom, where are you!?  Oh no, this is not the right one.

Script:534.2: scene-dialog-open|fswan|0|I don't know where this portal leads.  We should wait for Master Evalun.

Script:535.1: scene-dialog-open|luc|2|He's just a little boy, I can't abandon him there!  I have to be sure he's safe!

Script:536.1: scene-dialog-open|fswan|0|You've done more than enough!  Please just wait, don't try anything!

Script:541.1: scene-dialog-open|sda|0|Hm, I know your little rouse.  You used that girl to conserve your power.

Script:542.1: scene-dialog-open|eva|2|So what if I did?  When I reach your world I will kill the grand majin.

Script:543.1: scene-dialog-open|sda|0|Bah, do you think I would let your filth set foot on Issel?

Script:544.1: scene-dialog-open|eva|2|Oberon made the mistake of killing my father.  Now he will pay a price.

Script:545.1: scene-dialog-open|sda|0|We thought most humans were weak, but you are the few.  I will test you now!

Script:550.1: scene-dialog-open|sda|0|Bah, what an annoyance.  Can that sickly human even survive the ether?

Script:551.1: scene-dialog-open|sda|0|She can go kill that fake for all I care.  But no human can defeat me!

Script:559.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|What destructive powers!  How could you possibly have such an evil thing?

Script:560.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|I have seen many things on the other side.  Things you could not dream of.

Script:561.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|Why are you running then!?  Why don't you just blast them all away?

Script:562.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|I take the advice of Stradlater no matter how strange it may be.  The seer is always right.

Script:564.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|2|Yes my old prey!  I see you!  One shot is all I need!

Script:565.3: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|0|Damn all these humans!  Just don't fool around this time you degenerate!

Script:566.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|2|I'll shoot him right between the eyes ...  Wait is that far too merciful for him?

Script:567.2: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|0|Yes that's a good single minded lad.  Kill that fool now!

Script:568.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|2|But what if I shoot the girl?  That would hurt him even more!  Yes!

Script:569.2: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|0|No! No! What are you stupid!?  Kill the majin first!  Do you hear me!?

Script:571.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|0|There is something wrong, Chai come with me now!

Script:572.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|No! Don't you dare touch me!

Script:573.3: scene-dialog-open|leo|2|He loves her, but she doesn't love him!  Right before his eyes she'll die!

Script:577.2: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|Hey what's wrong, are you okay?  My God you're bleeding!

Script:579.3: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|0|Now is your chance!  Shoot the majin!  Shoot him now!

Script:580.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|2|Yes!  I get another chance to shoot that spoiled princess!

Script:581.1: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|0|No!  Are you trying to kill us!?  Half-wit!  Imbecile!  Idiot!

Script:582.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|2|What was that?  Huh, who is speaking to me?

Script:583.1: scene-dialog-open|fthorn|0|What!?  You can actually see me now!?  Impossible!

Script:584.1: scene-dialog-open|leo|2|Oh my God I understand now.  But its too late for me ...

Script:590.2: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|We are near the cathedral.  Your father is safe, and you can go now.

Script:591.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|Well thanks, I guess.  What will happen to you?

Script:592.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|I am going far away.  Do not be concerned where I go.  You are free.  Please leave.

Script:594.3: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|0|Wait!  You've seen his destructive power.  Is it right for you to let him go?

Script:595.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|I've never seen anything like it.  What unholy destruction ...

Script:596.2: scene-dialog-open|fleaf|0|Yes, he'll never be this weak again.  Father would be very proud of you!

Script:597.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|2|I guess I really have to, there is just no other way ...

Script:599.2: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|I'm very sorry Faust.  But you are just too dangerous for me to let you go.

Script:601.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|You are doing the right thing.  A person like me does not deserve to live.

Script:602.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|You have to be punished for your crimes you committed.  That's the way of justice.

Script:603.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|Yes, but please allow me to face my death, not with my back turned.

Script:604.1: scene-dialog-open|chai|0|Fine go ahead.  I will shoot you instantly if you try anything.

Script:607.1: scene-dialog-open|fau|2|I am so sorry for all the things I have done to you!  Please, please forgive me ...

Script:612.1: scene-dialog-open|tom|0|I feel so cold and sick.  My hands are shaking.  Where in the world am I?

Script:11.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|2|Remember that anytime you can press [ESC] for options and the [F1] key for help.

Script:12.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|0|To walk around press {up}, {down}, {left} or {right}.  To block just stand still or walk forward.

Script:14.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|2|Depending who you chose, you can only block a certain amount of damage.

Script:15.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|0|At the moment you block, you can press the {attack} button to push the enemy back!

Script:17.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|2|Also at that moment, you can press the {up} or {down} keys to evade further attacks.

Script:22.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|0|You can evade in other ways by pressing any direction button twice fast.

Script:23.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|2|Press {up} or {down} twice to side hop evade, and press {left} or {right} twice to run fast.

Script:26.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|0|For a simple combo attack press more than once or hold down the {attack} button.

Script:29.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|2|Press the {magic} button to launch a magic attack.  It will reduce your magic power.

Script:33.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|0|Use the {panic} button when there are lots of enemies and you are in a big panic!

Script:35.7: scene-dialog-open|leena|2|If you use all your magic you'll get hurt and be open to attack.  So don't get caught!

Script:37.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|0|You can do a special attack by pressing the {attack}+{magic} buttons at the same time.

Script:38.3: scene-dialog-open|leena|2|Special attacks usually have better range than normal attacks but are slow.

Script:41.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|0|The purple bars are for super attacks, it increases when you get hit or hit your enemies.

Script:42.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|2|The super goes down over time and has 3 levels.  Press {attack}+{magic}+{panic} to do a super.

Script:45.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|0|That's the end of the tutorial, but there's lots more secrets for you to unlock!

Script:46.1: scene-dialog-open|leena|2|Thanks for playing and supporting our game!  We really appreciate it!

Script:116.1: scene-dialog-open|erin|0|Hi, we're here to teach you how to play this game!  Press the {attack} key to continue.
